text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the "Japan Dirt Derby" just around the corner, I decided to enter Inari One into the "Takarazuka Kinen" to give her experience on a big stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running in this race is *that* Umamusume,
who has been taking the world by storm
with an unstoppable streak of victories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Battling against her is bound to become
invaluable nourishment for Inari One...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah~!
What an epic epithet!
It's so flashy, I can't help but be jealous!
choice_data_list: Your skill is the real deal.
Your skill is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya!
Let's see what that running style, dubbed "close to the strongest," is made of...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I've never felt pressure like this before...!
Could this really be—)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
ââWhat's the matter?
You chickening out?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Tamamo Cross... a runt with insane competitive spirit and an unbelievable finishing burst.
I know that better than anyone. But still—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(What the heck is up with her?!
She's like a completely different person from Tama at the academy!
Her whole body is overflowing with insane energy...!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Inari.
Right now, I'm sprintin' up to the top of Japan at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If you're going into this half-hearted,
you're gonna get burned real bad.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this, Tama!!
Let's see which one of us gets burned!"
